events.title: Martyrdom of the Twenty-Six Saints of Japan
events.description: Twenty-six Christians, including missionaries and Japanese converts, were crucified in Nagasaki on the orders of Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
events.significance: The executions marked a major escalation in the persecution of Christians in Japan and foreshadowed the later near-total suppression of Christianity under the Tokugawa shogunate.

events.title: Calabria Earthquakes Begin
events.description: A powerful earthquake struck Calabria in southern Italy, the first of a sequence of major quakes over the following weeks that devastated the region and killed tens of thousands of people.
events.significance: The sequence was among the first earthquakes to be studied systematically by a scientific commission, helping lay the groundwork for modern seismology.

events.title: Mexican Constitution of 1917 Promulgated
events.description: Following the Mexican Revolution, the new Constitution was proclaimed in Querétaro, establishing sweeping social and political reforms.
events.significance: It was one of the first constitutions to enshrine social rights such as labor protections, land reform, and secular education, and it remains in force today with amendments.

events.title: Apollo 14 Lands on the Moon
events.description: Astronauts Alan Shepard and Edgar Mitchell landed the lunar module Antares at the Fra Mauro highlands, while Stuart Roosa orbited above in the command module.
events.significance: Shepard famously hit golf balls on the lunar surface, and the mission returned about 42 kilograms of lunar samples, successfully restoring confidence in the Apollo program after Apollo 13.

events.title: Byron De La Beckwith Convicted of Medgar Evers Murder
events.description: Byron De La Beckwith was convicted in Mississippi of the 1963 assassination of civil rights leader Medgar Evers after two earlier trials ended in hung juries.
events.significance: The conviction, three decades after the crime, became a landmark in efforts to prosecute unresolved civil rights era murders.
